The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] owned a '''shuttle''' among the private craft reserved for his use. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] [[Dromund Kaas operation|confronted]] the Emperor on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Hero and crew stole the Emperor's shuttle from [[Kaas City]] so that they could reach the Emperor at the [[Dark Temple]].
